stories.hook: ¿Puede una sola sesión curar la depresión?
stories.headline: Una terapia cognitivo-conductual de un día reduce la depresión
stories.finding: En un ensayo controlado aleatorizado con 60 pacientes con trastorno depresivo mayor, una sesión de terapia cognitivo-conductual de un día redujo significativamente la depresión y la ansiedad y mejoró la autoestima frente a una lista de espera. Los beneficios se mantuvieron a las dos semanas.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo muestra que intervenciones breves y de bajo costo pueden ser efectivas para reducir síntomas depresivos, facilitando su implementación a gran escala en entornos con recursos limitados.
stories.paperTitle: One-Day Cognitive Behavioural Therapy for Major Depressive Disorder: A Randomised Controlled Trial in China
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Objective The translation of evidence-based psychological treatments into accessible, real-world care remains a central challenge in global mental health implementation. Although approximately 3.4% of Chinese adults meet criteria for Major Depressive Disorder (MDD), only around 12% receive any form of treatment. Developing brief, low-intensity psychological interventions that can be feasibly delivered at scale is therefore a pressing clinical and public health priority. Method This randomised controlled trial evaluated the effectiveness of a one-day CBT workshop (ODCBT) in reducing depression and anxiety symptoms and improving self-esteem among patients with MDD in mainland China. Sixty patients were randomly assigned to either the ODCBT condition or a wait-list control group, with outcomes assessed at baseline, immediately post-intervention, and at two-week follow-up. Results Compared with the wait-list group, patients receiving ODCBT demonstrated significant reductions in depressive and anxiety symptoms alongside significant improvements in self-esteem. These findings are consistent with prior one-day CBT trials and indicate that a single-session group format can produce clinically meaningful change. Conclusions ODCBT represents a scalable, low-resource intervention with potential for integration into stepped-care frameworks, offering a practical pathway toward addressing China’s depression treatment gap and informing future training and implementation efforts. Trial Registration : ChiCTR2400093783 Chinese Clinical Trial Registry https://clinicaltrials.gov/ct2/show/ChiCTR2400093783 .

stories.hook: ¿Qué desencadena la rumiación en momentos críticos?
stories.headline: Métodos de inducción de rumiación no generan efectos significativos
stories.finding: En un experimento con 86 participantes, tres técnicas de inducción de rumiación (memoria autobiográfica triste con tarea de manipulación de respuesta, película triste con memoria autobiográfica y tarea, y melodía triste con memoria) no produjeron diferencias estadísticamente significativas respecto a los controles. Sin embargo, entrevistas con ocho sujetos revelaron que la presencia de un recuerdo triste personal, un estado de ánimo bajo y alta sensibilidad emocional facilitan la rumiación, mientras que la ausencia de recuerdo, la revaluación positiva y la baja intensidad del estímulo la inhiben.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la inducción experimental de rumiación es difícil de lograr y que los factores personales y emocionales son clave, lo que orienta a clínicos a focalizar intervenciones en la reestructuración de recuerdos y en la regulación emocional.
stories.paperTitle: Hetkeseisundi rumineerimise esilekutsumise meetodite ja mõjude võrdlus
stories.originalAbstract: Study piloted effects of different state rumination induction methods and qualitatively studied what factors facilitate or inhibit rumination induction. Three methods were used: sad autobiographical memory with Response Manipulation Task (RMT); sad film with autobiographical memory and RMT; sad melody with sad autobiographical memory and RMT. Control groups had same conditions without rumination and negative valence components. 86 people completed online experiment, and 8 participated in interviews. Results were statistically not significant. Based on the interviews, factors inducing rumination were: presence of personally significant sad memory; prior low mood; and self-reported emotional sensitivity. Inhibiting factors included: absence of significant memory; positive reappraisal during task; perceived low intensity of stimuli. Results of study contribute to understanding rumination mechanisms and to improvement of experimental paradigms.

stories.hook: ¿Es el trastorno de pánico realmente una categoría?
stories.headline: Análisis taxométrico revela naturaleza dimensional del trastorno de pánico
stories.finding: Se aplicaron tres procedimientos taxométricos a siete indicadores del Panic Disorder Severity Scale en una muestra de 663 participantes reclutados vía Amazon Mechanical Turk. Los índices de ajuste y los gráficos comparativos mostraron soporte consistente para un modelo dimensional del trastorno de pánico (CCFI medio = 0,39).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo cuestiona la validez de la clasificación categórica del trastorno de pánico, sugiriendo que la evaluación y el acceso a tratamientos deberían basarse en un continuo de gravedad, lo que podría mejorar la precisión diagnóstica y la asignación de intervenciones.
stories.paperTitle: A taxometric analysis of panic disorder
stories.originalAbstract: Panic disorder is costly, and while evidence-based interventions for panic disorder are effective, obtaining a diagnosis often precludes access to such treatments. This is problematic because the categorical diagnosis of panic disorder (i.e. "you have it, or you don't") supported by modern diagnostic manuals contradicts empirically supported dimensional models of panic disorder. Taxometric analyses, which test the dimensional or categorical latent structure of constructs, have consistently revealed dimensional latent structures when applied to other anxiety disorders and panic-related processes, but taxometric analyses have never been applied to panic disorder. To address this gap in the literature, three nonredundant taxometric procedures were applied to seven theoretically-relevant indicators of panic disorder derived from Panic Disorder Severity Scale data collected from 663 participants recruited via Amazon Mechanical Turk. Simulated comparison plots and objective fit indices were also evaluated. The collective results provided consistent empirical support for a dimensional model of panic disorder, with an overall mean CCFI score of .39. The implications of the present findings for the measurement, assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of panic disorder are discussed.

stories.hook: ¿Qué terapia funciona mejor para el PTSD infantil?
stories.headline: TCC y EMDR, tratamientos eficaces contra el PTSD juvenil
stories.finding: Una revisión sistemática bajo PRISMA analizó intervenciones psicoterapéuticas para PTSD en niños (6‑12 años) y adolescentes (12‑18 años). Los hallazgos destacan a la TCC, la TCC centrada en trauma y la EMDR como tratamientos con evidencia de efectividad para disminuir evitación, flashbacks, depresión y ansiedad.
stories.takeaway: Este dato orienta a los profesionales a priorizar intervenciones basadas en TCC para el PTSD juvenil, garantizando tratamientos con respaldo empírico y mejorando pronósticos de desarrollo.
stories.paperTitle: Clinical Efficacy of Psychotherapeutic Interventions for Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder in Children and Adolescents: A Systematic Review and Analysis
stories.originalAbstract: Background: This systematic review aggregates research on psychotherapeutic interventions for Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) in children and adolescents. PTSD in this demographic presents differently from adults, necessitating tailored therapeutic approaches. In children and adolescents, PTSD arises from exposure to severe danger, interpersonal violence, or abuse, leading to significant behavioral and emotional disturbances that jeopardize long-term development. The review focuses on describing PTSD within two age groups, children (6 to 12 years) and adolescents (12 to 18 years), while evaluating the effectiveness of various clinical interventions aimed at this condition. Methods: Utilizing the PRISMA guidelines, this review systematically examines studies that assess clinical interventions for PTSD in the younger population. Results: Key symptoms of PTSD in children and adolescents include avoidance, overstimulation, flashbacks, depression, and anxiety. The review identifies several effective treatments, including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Trauma-Focused CBT (TF-CBT), Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), Systemic Therapy, Play Therapy, Exposure Therapy, Relaxation Techniques, and Psychodynamic Psychotherapy. Particularly, TF-CBT is highlighted as the most effective and commonly used method in treating childhood and adolescent PTSD, as supported by most of the studies reviewed. Conclusions: A significant outcome of this study is the short-term effectiveness of CBT in reducing PTSD symptoms in children and adolescents. The findings underline the importance of psychotherapeutic interventions and mark a substantial advancement in understanding PTSD in young populations. It is crucial for practitioners to integrate various psychotherapeutic strategies into their practice to improve patient outcomes and treatment efficacy.

stories.hook: ¿Amenaza o privación, cuál da más riesgo psicopatológico?
stories.headline: La amenaza infantil se asocia más fuertemente con psicopatología que la privación
stories.finding: Una meta‑análisis preregistrada de 127 artículos (N = 163 767) examinó cómo las dimensiones de adversidad infantil (amenaza y privación) se relacionan con la psicopatología juvenil. Se encontró que la amenaza se asoció significativamente con una mayor magnitud de psicopatología interna, externa y específica de trauma que la privación.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que los niños expuestos a amenazas requieren intervenciones focalizadas, pues presentan mayor riesgo de trastornos, mientras que la privación sigue siendo relevante pero con efectos menos intensos, orientando la evaluación y el tratamiento basado en la naturaleza del trauma.
stories.paperTitle: Do dimensions of childhood adversity differ in their direct associations with youth psychopathology? A meta-analysis
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Growing evidence supports the unique pathways by which threat and deprivation, two core dimensions of adversity, confer risk for youth psychopathology. However, the extent to which these dimensions differ in their direct associations with youth psychopathology remains unclear. The primary aim of this preregistered meta-analysis was to synthesize the associations between threat, deprivation, internalizing, externalizing, and trauma-specific psychopathology. Because threat is proposed to be directly linked with socioemotional development, we hypothesized that the magnitude of associations between threat and psychopathology would be larger than those with deprivation. We conducted a search for peer-reviewed articles in English using PubMed and PsycINFO databases through August 2022. Studies that assessed both threat and deprivation and used previously validated measures of youth psychopathology were included. One hundred and twenty-seven articles were included in the synthesis (N = 163,767). Results of our three-level meta-analyses indicated that adversity dimension significantly moderated the associations between adversity and psychopathology, such that the magnitude of effects for threat (r’s = .21–26) were consistently larger than those for deprivation (r’s = .16–.19). These differences were more pronounced when accounting for the threat-deprivation correlation. Additional significant moderators included emotional abuse and youth self-report of adversity. Findings are consistent with the Dimensional Model of Adversity and Psychopathology, with clinical, research, and policy implications.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo adaptar la interpretación al trauma complejo?
stories.headline: Cinco ejes para una práctica psicoanalítica sensible al trauma
stories.finding: Una revisión de alcance de los últimos quince años identificó cinco ejes que estructuran la práctica psicoanalítica sensible al trauma: vulnerabilidad a la desregulación, acceso simbólico limitado, disociación estructural, vulnerabilidad a la desorganización íntima y enactments de colusiones disociativas. Se propone calibrar la interpretación a la capacidad simbólica del paciente.
stories.takeaway: Este esquema guía a los clínicos para ajustar la intervención interpretativa a las limitaciones regulatorias y simbólicas del paciente traumatizado, favoreciendo una mayor tolerancia al material traumático y potencialmente mejorando los resultados terapéuticos en contextos de disociación y vulnerabilidad relacional.
stories.paperTitle: Recent trends and adaptations in trauma-informed psychoanalytic psychotherapies: A scoping review.
stories.originalAbstract: A growing sensitivity has emerged within psychoanalytic theory and intervention to the specific conditions of complex posttraumatic pathology and its clinical challenges. Yet an articulated, encompassing view of the diverse proposals within this new sensitivity is still lacking. This article advances such articulation through a scoping review of psychoanalytic interventions focused on trauma and dissociation published over the past 15 years. Our analysis identifies five axes of trauma-sensitive psychoanalytic practice addressing vulnerability to dysregulation, limited symbolic access to traumatic material, structural dissociation, vulnerability to disorganization in contexts of intimacy, and enactments arising around dissociative collusions and dilemmas of recognition within the therapeutic dyad. Overall, the reviewed literature relocates interpretation within a temporally and clinically responsive framework, in which the timing and form of interpretive interventions are calibrated to the traumatized patient's regulatory, dissociative, and symbolic capacities. We conclude by outlining essential aspects of the therapeutic stance implied by these contributions. (PsycInfo Database Record (c) 2026 APA, all rights reserved).

stories.hook: ¿Cómo influye la interocepción en la gravedad del TOC?
stories.headline: Perfiles interoceptivos predicen la severidad del trastorno obsesivo‑compulsivo
stories.finding: En una muestra comunitaria de 362 personas se hallaron cuatro perfiles latentes de sensibilidad interoceptiva. Los perfiles “Distressed and Disconnected” y “Anxiously Aware” mostraron mayor severidad de síntomas de TOC que los otros dos perfiles.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la interocepción disfuncional constituye un marcador clínico de mayor gravedad del TOC, orientando intervenciones que apunten a mejorar la regulación interoceptiva.
stories.paperTitle: From Perception to Preoccupation: The Relationship Between Latent Profiles of Interoceptive Sensibility and Obsessive-Compulsive Symptom Severity in a Community Sample
stories.journal: Journal of Psychopathology and Behavioral Assessment
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Recent research has proposed a role for atypical interoception in obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) symptoms. Interoceptive sensibility, or one’s subjective tendency to experience and engage with bodily sensations, may be implicated in the anxious appraisal of sensations in OCD. The current study aimed to identify latent profiles of interoceptive sensibility and explore their relationship with OCD symptoms in a large cross-sectional community sample ( n = 362) with varying levels of OCD symptom severity. Four profiles of interoceptive sensibility were revealed: “Distressed and Disconnected”; “Anxiously Aware”; “Elevated Engagement”; and “Resilient Regulation”. The profiles were distinguishable from one another on regulatory capacity, bodily trust, and the anxious interpretation and avoidance of uncomfortable bodily sensations, as well as varying levels of bodily and emotional attentiveness. When comparing profiles on OCD symptom severity, the Distressed and Disconnected and Anxiously Aware profiles demonstrated significantly higher OCD symptom severity than the Elevated Engagement and Resilient Regulation profiles. This pattern was also largely consistent across OCD symptom dimensions. These findings provide additional insight into proposed dichotomous views of “adaptive” and “maladaptive” interoceptive sensibility and the ambiguous nature of heightened bodily attentiveness. Further research is necessary to replicate the current findings in a clinical sample.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la melatonina frenar el envejecimiento cerebral post‑COVID?
stories.headline: Melatonina como inhibidor de ferroptosis para prevenir neurodegeneración post‑COVID
stories.finding: Los autores describen que la melatonina actúa como inhibidor de ferroptosis, proceso de muerte celular dependiente del hierro, implicado en la neuroinflamación y el envejecimiento acelerado tras la COVID-19. Diversos estudios reportan que la melatonina reduce la neurodegeneración y mejora la función cognitiva en este contexto.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la melatonina podría ser una intervención segura y accesible para mitigar el deterioro cognitivo y la neurodegeneración en sobrevivientes de COVID-19, abriendo una vía terapéutica basada en la inhibición de ferroptosis.
stories.paperTitle: Melatonin: a ferroptosis inhibitor with potential therapeutic efficacy for the post-COVID-19 trajectory of accelerated brain aging and neurodegeneration
stories.originalAbstract: The unprecedented pandemic of COVID-19 swept millions of lives in a short period, yet its menace continues among its survivors in the form of post-COVID syndrome. An exponentially growing number of COVID-19 survivors suffer from cognitive impairment, with compelling evidence of a trajectory of accelerated aging and neurodegeneration. The novel and enigmatic nature of this yet-to-unfold pathology demands extensive research seeking answers for both the molecular underpinnings and potential therapeutic targets. Ferroptosis, an iron-dependent cell death, is a strongly proposed underlying mechanism in post-COVID-19 aging and neurodegeneration discourse. COVID-19 incites neuroinflammation, iron dysregulation, reactive oxygen species (ROS) accumulation, antioxidant system repression, renin-angiotensin system (RAS) disruption, and clock gene alteration. These events pave the way for ferroptosis, which shows its signature in COVID-19, premature aging, and neurodegenerative disorders. In the search for a treatment, melatonin shines as a promising ferroptosis inhibitor with its repeatedly reported safety and tolerability. According to various studies, melatonin has proven efficacy in attenuating the severity of certain COVID-19 manifestations, validating its reputation as an anti-viral compound. Melatonin has well-documented anti-aging properties and combating neurodegenerative-related pathologies. Melatonin can block the leading events of ferroptosis since it is an efficient anti-inflammatory, iron chelator, antioxidant, angiotensin II antagonist, and clock gene regulator. Therefore, we propose ferroptosis as the culprit behind the post-COVID-19 trajectory of aging and neurodegeneration and melatonin, a well-fitting ferroptosis inhibitor, as a potential treatment.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la atención plena prevenir el suicidio?
stories.headline: Mindfulness reduce la ideación suicida según meta‑análisis
stories.finding: El meta‑análisis de intervenciones basadas en mindfulness mostró una reducción significativa de la ideación suicida, con efectos de tratamiento descritos como fuertes. Los estudios incluidos evidenciaron que la práctica de mindfulness está inversamente asociada con la ideación y los intentos suicidas.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que incorporar mindfulness en programas de prevención puede disminuir la carga suicida y ofrecer una herramienta basada en evidencia para clínicas y servicios de salud mental.
stories.paperTitle: Mindfulness and self-compassion: Applications for suicide and non-suicidal self-injury
stories.originalAbstract: Background: Non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI) involves intentionally causing damage to bodily tissue without suicidal intent. Though distinct from suicide, NSSI is a strong predictor of both suicidal ideation and attempts. Although NSSI and suicide are each highly prevalent mental health concerns, few interventions exist to address these phenomena. Mindfulness and compassion are two traits that have been shown to protect against a number of mental health concerns, including suicide and NSSI. Trait mindfulness and self-compassion are each inversely associated with both suicide and NSSI; however, little research has investigated their utility in treating these concerns. Chapter III: Though several studies have examined the effectiveness of mindfulness-based interventions on suicide-related outcomes, it is unclear on a broader level how effective these interventions may be in addressing suicidal ideation. Chapter III of this dissertation presents a meta-analysis of the effectiveness of mindfulness-based interventions on suicide-related outcomes. Results suggest that mindfulness-based interventions may be effective in reducing suicidal ideation, and that treatment effects tend to be stronger in older samples, samples with more female participants, and when participants spend more total hours in treatment.Chapter IV: The results of Chapter III raise the question of whether mindfulness-based interventions may be feasible for and acceptable to individuals who engage in self-injury, given the strong association that exists between suicidal ideation and NSSI. Chapter IV presents the results of a mixed-methods feasibility study of an embodied and embedded mindfulness and compassion-based intervention for individuals who engage in NSSI. Results of this study suggest that the intervention was acceptable to participants, and clinically meaningful reductions in anxiety and depression were observed. These results should be considered in light of the study’s small sample size and the potential impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on those who participated.Chapter V: At present, it is unclear how the pandemic may have impacted those who engage in NSSI. Chapter V outlines an exploratory mixed-methods study of the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on individuals who engage in NSSI. Quantitative results indicated that loneliness strengthened the association between urges to self-injure and weekly self-injury engagement. Isolation emerged as an important theme in qualitative analyses, as did Changes in Coping, Stressors, and No Change. Conclusion: Overall, this dissertation examined the feasibility and effectiveness of mindfulness- and compassion-based interventions for suicide and NSSI, as well as the protective role that mindfulness and self-compassion may play with regard to urges to self-injure and self-injury behaviour. The results of this dissertation suggest that mindfulness and self-compassion are potentially promising intervention strategies for suicidal ideation and self-injury

Isolation emerged as an important theme in qualitative analyses, as did Changes in Coping, Stressors, and No Change. Conclusion: Overall, this dissertation examined the feasibility and effectiveness of mindfulness- and compassion-based interventions for suicide and NSSI, as well as the protective role that mindfulness and self-compassion may play with regard to urges to self-injure and self-injury behaviour. The results of this dissertation suggest that mindfulness and self-compassion are potentially promising intervention strategies for suicidal ideation and self-injury

stories.hook: ¿Puede la terapia ACT mejorar la autoestima?
stories.headline: ACT reduce vergüenza interna y ansiedad en estudiantes de enfermería
stories.finding: En un estudio cuasi‑experimental con 36 estudiantes de enfermería, el grupo experimental recibió ocho sesiones de 90 min de terapia de aceptación y compromiso (ACT) mientras que el grupo control no recibió intervención. Los análisis MANCOVA mostraron que la ACT produjo una disminución significativa de la vergüenza internalizada, el miedo al éxito y la sensibilidad a la ansiedad.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la ACT, al fomentar la flexibilidad psicológica y la autocompasión, puede ser una herramienta eficaz para fortalecer la autoestima y reducir la autocrítica en futuros profesionales de la salud.
stories.paperTitle: The Efficacy of Acceptance and Commitment Therapy on Internalized Shame, Fear of Success, and Anxiety Sensitivity in Nursing With Imposter
stories.originalAbstract: The Efficacy of Acceptance and Commitment Therapy on Internalized Shame, Fear of Success, and Anxiety Sensitivity in Nursing With ImposterBackground: Imposter phenomenon (IP), marked by self-doubt and fear of exposure, is common among high-achieving individuals, including nursing students facing academic and clinical pressures.These challenges heighten shame, fear of success, and anxiety sensitivity, harming mental health and performance.Acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), focusing on psychological flexibility, is a promising intervention.This study evaluated the ACT's effectiveness in reducing these patterns in nursing students with IP.Methods: This quasi-experimental study used a parallel-group design with pre-test and post-test measures.Thirty-six nursing students with IP from Tehran (Districts 7 and 8) were purposively sampled and non-randomly assigned to the experimental (n=18) and control (n=18) groups.The experimental group attended eight 90-minute ACT sessions, while the control group received no intervention.Data were collected using validated psychological scales and analyzed using MANCOVA, adjusting for baseline scores.Results: The findings revealed that ACT led to a significant reduction in internalized shame (F=39.86,P<0.001), fear of success (F=57.27,P<0.001), and anxiety sensitivity, including its physical (F=56.55,P<0.001), cognitive (F=45.58,P<0.001), and social (F=47.41,P<0.001) dimensions.The effect sizes were large, indicating substantial improvements in the mental health of the experimental group compared to the control group (P<0.001).Conclusion: ACT effectively reduces internalized shame, fear of success, and anxiety sensitivity in nursing students with IP.By fostering psychological flexibility and value-driven behavior, ACT may enhance mental health, academic resilience, and professional confidence.Integrating ACT into nursing education could support students' psychological well-being and success.

stories.hook: ¿Qué estrés laboral desencadena cada tipo de burnout en enfermería?
stories.headline: Dimensiones específicas del estrés ocupacional predicen subescalas de burnout en enfermeras
stories.finding: En un estudio transversal con 3,654 enfermeras, se observó estrés ocupacional leve‑moderado (media total = 64.19 ± 21.20) y niveles notables de burnout (EE = 21.33 ± 5.87, DP = 10.06 ± 3.20, PA = 23.13 ± 4.23). El análisis de regresión logística multivariable reveló que cada una de las cinco dimensiones de estrés se asoció significativamente con una o más subescalas de burnout.
stories.takeaway: Identificar qué facetas del estrés impulsan la extenuación, la despersonalización o la pérdida de realización permite diseñar intervenciones focalizadas y prevenir el burnout en el personal de enfermería, mejorando la calidad asistencial y la retención del personal.
stories.paperTitle: Differential associations of occupational stress dimensions with job burnout subscales among nurses
stories.originalAbstract: Background The differential associations through which specific dimensions of occupational stress contribute to distinct components of job burnout among nurses remain insufficiently elucidated, particularly in the post-pandemic context. This study aimed to assess the status of occupational stress and burnout and, crucially, to investigate the specific associations between stress dimensions and burnout components among clinical nurses. Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted and 3,654 registered nurses who completed an anonymous online survey. Validated instruments were utilized to assess job burnout and nursing occupational stress across multiple domains. Multivariable logistic regression analyses were performed to identify occupational stress factors independently associated with each dimension of job burnout. Results Nurses reported mild-to-moderate overall occupational stress (mean total score = 64.19 ± 21.20; mean item score = 1.83 ± 0.61). However, burnout levels were notable, with scores of 21.33 ± 5.87 for emotional exhaustion (EE), 10.06 ± 3.20 for depersonalization (DP), and 23.13 ± 4.23 for personal accomplishment (PA). All five stress dimensions showed significant positive correlations with EE ( r = 0.436–0.542) and DP ( r = 0.345–0.489), and weak negative correlations with PA ( r = −0.122 to −0.150). Regression analyses revealed distinct patterns of association: EE was independently associated with all five stress dimensions, most strongly with “nursing management and interpersonal relationships” (NMIR) (OR = 3.738, 95% CI: 2.294–6.089, p < 0.001) and “workload and time allocation” (WTA) (OR = 2.801, 95% CI: 2.205–3.559, p < 0.001). DP was specifically associated with “patient nursing care” (OR = 2.401, 95% CI: 1.564–3.688, p < 0.001), NMIR (OR = 2.036, 95% CI: 1.139–3.639, p = 0.016), and “work environment and resources” (OR = 1.486, 95% CI: 1.075–2.054, p = 0.017). For low PA, only NMIR (OR = 3.415, 95% CI: 1.772–6.583, p < 0.001) and WTA (OR = 0.556, 95% CI: 0.347–0.890, p = 0.014) were significant independent factors, with NMIR stress being the strongest correlate. Conclusion This study identifies a disconnect between moderate stress perception and significant burnout, highlighting heterogeneous associations linking specific stress dimensions to different burnout components. It underscores stress related to management and interpersonal relationships as a central, pervasive factor associated with burnout. Interventions targeting organizational leadership and the relational climate are essential for mitigating burnout and fostering nurse well-being.

stories.hook: ¿Puede una IA predecir la calidad de tu relación?
stories.headline: Red neuronal profunda predice la calidad de la relación de pareja con alta precisión
stories.finding: Los autores entrenaron una red neuronal profunda con cuatro capas ocultas usando datos de 680 adultos en relaciones comprometidas, divididos en conjuntos de entrenamiento (n=476), validación (n=102) y prueba independiente (n=102). El modelo alcanzó un desempeño predictivo sólido según métricas de error y coeficiente de determinación.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que herramientas de aprendizaje profundo pueden complementar la evaluación clínica, permitiendo identificar parejas en riesgo y orientar intervenciones tempranas basadas en perfiles multidimensionales.
stories.paperTitle: Deep Neural Network Prediction of Couple Relationship Quality Using Multidimensional Relational and Psychological Features
stories.originalAbstract: Objective: This study aimed to develop and evaluate a deep neural network model for predicting couple relationship quality using multidimensional relational, psychological, contextual, and demographic features. Methods and Materials: This quantitative cross-sectional predictive study was conducted with 680 adults involved in committed romantic relationships and residing in Canada. Participants completed standardized assessments of relationship quality, relationship satisfaction, communication quality, conflict processes, perceived partner responsiveness, emotional intimacy, commitment, trust, attachment anxiety and avoidance, depressive symptoms, anxiety, perceived stress, emotion regulation, self-esteem, psychological well-being, and selected contextual characteristics. The dataset was divided into training (n = 476), validation (n = 102), and independent test (n = 102) subsets. A feedforward deep neural network with four hidden layers was trained using the Adam optimizer, dropout regularization, batch normalization, and early stopping. Predictive performance was evaluated using mean absolute error, mean squared error, root mean squared error, and coefficient of determination and was compared with multiple linear regression, ridge regression, random forest regression, and gradient-boosted regression. SHAP analysis was used to interpret feature importance. Findings: The deep neural network demonstrated the strongest predictive performance on the independent test set, with MAE = 3.91, MSE = 26.63, RMSE = 5.16, and R² = .84. It outperformed multiple linear regression (R² = .64), ridge regression (R² = .66), random forest regression (R² = .74), and gradient-boosted regression (R² = .78). The most influential predictors were relationship satisfaction, perceived partner responsiveness, destructive conflict, communication quality, emotional intimacy, attachment anxiety, commitment, trust, perceived stress, and attachment avoidance. Sensitivity analysis showed that removing relationship satisfaction reduced model performance to R² = .76, while the multidimensional full model retained the highest accuracy. Conclusion: Deep neural networks can accurately predict couple relationship quality by integrating relational and psychological features and may provide a useful framework for identifying complex nonlinear patterns relevant to relationship assessment and intervention.

stories.headline: Modelo dual‑sistema explica el comportamiento prosocial riesgoso
stories.finding: Los autores proponen un modelo dual‑sistema que integra el impulso emocional y el razonamiento cognitivo para explicar el comportamiento prosocial riesgoso. Además, diseñaron un paradigma experimental en decisiones económicas y demostraron preliminarmente su fiabilidad.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo aporta una herramienta teórica y metodológica para evaluar y predecir conductas altruistas bajo riesgo, facilitando intervenciones clínicas y políticas que fomenten la cooperación segura en contextos de incertidumbre.
stories.paperTitle: Dual‐System Collaborative Model of Prosocial Risky Behavior and Cognitive Computation: A Review
stories.originalAbstract: Prosocial risky behavior (PRB) refers to actions taken at personal risk for the benefit of others or societal welfare, combining risk-taking with prosocial intent, and involving the integrated processing of individual risk and social preferences. Building upon the review and evaluation of the definitions of PRB, existing research tools, theoretical models, and neural mechanisms, this paper elucidates the synergistic interaction and mechanisms of the emotional drive and cognitive reasoning systems in PRB. It constructs a dual-system collaborative model for PRB. Furthermore, to address the shortcomings of existing PRB research tools, such as limited cross-domain applicability and low reliability, this paper designs a PRB research paradigm within the economic decision-making domain. Combined with the dual-system collaborative model of PRB, this paper proposes a cognitive computational modeling concept for PRB and preliminarily verifies its reliability. Future research should conduct cross-cultural studies, utilizing cognitive neuroscientific technologies, to explore the cultural differences in the mechanisms underlying PRB, thereby enhancing the cross-cultural interpretive power of the constructed dual-system collaborative model of PRB. This broadens the theoretical explanatory pathways and research dimensions of PRB.

stories.headline: Notificaciones móviles bien diseñadas fomentan compras impulsivas
stories.finding: En un estudio cualitativo con 17 participantes, se analizó cómo el contenido, la personalización, el momento y la frecuencia de notificaciones instantáneas afectan actitudes hacia ellas. Los usuarios que percibieron las notificaciones de forma positiva mostraron mayor propensión a compras impulsivas.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la configuración de notificaciones en apps de comercio puede modular el comportamiento impulsivo, ofreciendo una vía para diseñar intervenciones que reduzcan el gasto no planificado.
stories.paperTitle: Tüketicilerin Mobil Anlık Bildirimlere Tepkileri ve İmpulsif Satın Alma ile İlişkisinin Nitel Analizi
stories.originalAbstract: Purpose: This study explores various aspects of consumer experiences related to instant notifications sent by online shopping platforms to consumers' smartphones and their potential relationship with impulsive buying behaviors.Methodology: Primary data were obtained from 17 participants accessed through purposive sampling within the framework of qualitative research methodology. Data from participants were collected via structured interviews using a structured questionnaire. The collected data were analyzed under the framework of descriptive analysis, focusing on specific themes.Findings: The findings from the analysis indicated that factors such as the content, level of personalization, timing, and frequency of instant notifications sent by online shopping platforms significantly influence users' attitudes toward these notifications. Participants who responded positively to the notifications exhibited tendencies towards impulsive buying.Implications: Based on the study’s findings, it is understood that well-designed, timely, and appropriately frequent instant notifications from online shopping applications can influence consumers' purchase decisions, potentially leading to impulsive buying behaviors and shaping users' overall shopping attitudes. These results are believed to contribute to the literature and online shopping practices by offering insights into how notifications can impact consumer behavior.Limitations: It should be noted that the study's findings and conclusions are based on qualitative research methodology, utilizing data obtained from a study group of 17 individuals. Therefore, evaluations based on these findings are limited to the scope of this participant sample.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la terapia focalizada reducir el trauma en jóvenes desplazados?
stories.headline: La consejería psicosocial focalizada disminuye significativamente el estrés post‑traumático en jóvenes nigerianos
stories.finding: En un diseño cuasi‑experimental con 300 jóvenes desplazados (15‑24 años) en el noroeste de Nigeria, el grupo experimental recibió consejería psicosocial focalizada mientras que el control recibió consejería de alivio convencional. El grupo experimental obtuvo ganancias medias mucho mayores en reducción de síntomas de estrés post‑traumático (1,83 vs 0,10), regulación emocional (1,45 vs 0,10) y reintegración social (1,58 vs 0,08), y el ANCOVA mostró efectos de grupo significativos (F(1,297)=512,44; p<.001).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo indica que la consejería psicosocial focalizada es una intervención eficaz para fortalecer la resiliencia y la recuperación tras el trauma en poblaciones vulnerables, proporcionando una herramienta práctica para profesionales que atienden a jóvenes desplazados.
stories.paperTitle: TRAUMA-FOCUSED PSYCHOSOCIAL COUNSELLING FOR YOUTH AFFECTED BY TERRORISM AND BANDITRY IN CONFLICT-AFFECTED REGIONS OF NIGERIA
stories.originalAbstract: This study evaluated the effects of a trauma-focused psychosocial counselling framework on selected dimensions of psychosocial well-being among young people affected by terrorism and banditry in North-West Nigeria. A quasi-experimental pretest-posttest non-equivalent control-group design was adopted. The sample comprised 300 internally displaced young people aged 15-24 years drawn from camps in Zamfara, Katsina and Kaduna States. The experimental group (n = 150) received the trauma-focused psychosocial counselling programme, while the control group (n = 150) received conventional relief counselling. Data were collected with the Youth Trauma and Psychosocial Well-being Inventory (YTPWI; α = .88) and analysed with descriptive statistics and analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) at the .05 significance level. The experimental group recorded substantially larger mean gains than the control group in post-traumatic stress symptom reduction (1.83 versus 0.10), emotional regulation (1.45 versus 0.10) and social reintegration (1.58 versus 0.08). ANCOVA further indicated statistically significant group effects for the cognitive-behavioural trauma-therapy component, F(1, 297) = 512.44, p < .001; the resilience-building counselling component, F(1, 297) = 433.81, p < .001; and the grief and bereavement counselling component, F(1, 297) = 489.15, p < .001. The findings support the use of structured trauma-focused psychosocial counselling for conflict-affected young people, while also indicating the need for culturally responsive delivery, competent supervision and sustained psychosocial follow-up. The study recommends integrating trauma-focused, resilience and grief-responsive counselling into humanitarian and educational rehabilitation services for displaced young people in conflict-affected Nigerian communities.

stories.hook: ¿Los lectores menos hábiles son más vulnerables a la interferencia?
stories.headline: Los lectores con menor habilidad presentan mayor interferencia proactiva en tareas no verbales
stories.finding: En una muestra de 42 niños coreanos, los lectores menos hábiles mostraron tiempos de respuesta más lentos y menor precisión en ensayos de distracción (lure) que los lectores hábiles. Además, sus índices de interferencia proactiva fueron significativamente mayores tanto en velocidad como en exactitud.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la dificultad lectora está vinculada a déficits de control inhibitorio que trascienden el lenguaje, lo que podría influir en la evaluación y el entrenamiento cognitivo de niños con problemas de atención.
stories.paperTitle: Reading Comprehension Skill and Inhibition of Proactive Interference
stories.journal: Eon'eo cheong'gag jang'ae yeon'gu/Communication sciences & disorders
stories.originalAbstract: Objectives: This study examined whether resistance to proactive interference (PI) differs between Highly Skilled Readers (HSR) and Less-skilled Readers (LSR) under nonverbal task demands. Methods: Forty-two Korean children were classified into the HSR and LSR groups based on standardized reading comprehension scores. Participants completed a nonverbal directed forgetting task assessing resistance to PI, with performance indexed by response time (RT) and accuracy. Results: Significant group×probe type interactions were observed for both RT and accuracy. The LSR group showed longer RTs and lower accuracy on lure trials, together with significantly larger PI indices for both measures. Conclusion: The findings suggest that less-skilled readers are more vulnerable to PI under nonverbal task demands. This pattern raises the possibility that differences in inhibitory control associated with reading comprehension skill extend beyond language-based processing.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué los hombres prefieren juegos y las mujeres redes sociales?
stories.headline: Hombres muestran mayor adicción a juegos; mujeres, mayor adicción a redes sociales
stories.finding: En una muestra de 585 jóvenes españoles (M = 22.11 años), los hombres obtuvieron puntuaciones significativamente más altas en adicción a internet (IA) e Internet Gaming Disorder (IGD) que las mujeres. En contraste, las mujeres presentaron puntuaciones superiores en adicción a redes sociales (SMA) y en la dimensión de “obsesión por el teléfono” del phubbing, sin diferencias de género en la dimensión de “perturbación de la comunicación”.
stories.takeaway: Estos hallazgos sugieren la necesidad de diseñar intervenciones preventivas y terapéuticas diferenciadas por género, enfocándose en los patrones específicos de uso digital que predisponen a trastornos de adicción en hombres y mujeres.
stories.paperTitle: Exploring Gender Differences in Internet Addiction and Psychological Factors: A Study in a Spanish Sample
stories.originalAbstract: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: Internet addiction (IA) and related behaviors, such as Internet Gaming Disorder (IGD) and social media addiction (SMA), have gained increasing research attention. Studies show gender differences, with males more likely to develop gaming-related addictions and females more prone to social media and phubbing behaviors. This study aimed to explore gender differences in Internet addiction and related behaviors in a Spanish sample, with the goal of identifying predictors and gender-specific patterns of IA. METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional study with 585 participants (265 male, 320 female) aged 18 to 35 years (M = 22.11, SD = 3.08). Data were collected using standardized questionnaires to assess IA, IGD, SMA, phubbing, Fear of Missing Out (FoMO), emotional dysregulation, personality traits, and prosociality. Correlation and regression analyses were used to identify gender-specific predictors of IA. RESULTS: Males exhibited significantly higher scores for IA and IGD, while females showed higher scores for SMA and the "phone obsession" dimension of phubbing. No significant gender differences were found in the "communication disturbance" dimension of phubbing or in FoMO. Correlation analyses revealed significant associations between IA and psychological as well as technological variables. Gender-specific predictors of IA included social media engagement and emotional regulation for females, while gaming behaviors and communication patterns were more relevant for males. CONCLUSIONS: These findings highlight gender differences in IA, suggesting that tailored interventions should address unique online behaviors and emotional regulation challenges in males and females. Future research should refine gender-specific patterns to develop more effective, targeted prevention and treatment strategies.
stories.abstract: BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: Internet addiction (IA) and related behaviors, such as Internet Gaming Disorder (IGD) and social media addiction (SMA), have gained increasing research attention. Studies show gender differences, with males more likely to develop gaming-related addictions and females more prone to social media and phubbing behaviors. This study aimed to explore gender differences in Internet addiction and related behaviors in a Spanish sample, with the goal of identifying predictors and gender-specific patterns of IA. METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional study with 585 participants (265 male, 320 female) aged 18 to 35 years (M = 22.11, SD = 3.08). Data were collected using standardized questionnaires to assess IA, IGD, SMA, phubbing, Fear of Missing Out (FoMO), emotional dysregulation, personality traits, and prosociality. Correlation and regression analyses were used to identify gender-specific predictors of IA. RESULTS: Males exhibited significantly higher scores for IA and IGD, while females showed higher scores for SMA and the "phone obsession" dimension of phubbing. No significant gender differences were found in the "communication disturbance" dimension of phubbing or in FoMO. Correlation analyses revealed significant associations between IA and psychological as well as technological variables. Gender-specific predictors of IA included social media engagement and emotional regulation for females, while gaming behaviors and communication patterns were more relevant for males. CONCLUSIONS: These findings highlight gender differences in IA, suggesting that tailored interventions should address unique online behaviors and emotional regulation challenges in males and females. Future research should refine gender-specific patterns to develop more effective, targeted prevention and treatment strategies.

stories.headline: La exposición crónica al ruido produce deterioro estructural y funcional en el cerebro
stories.finding: La exposición crónica al ruido reduce neurogénesis, provoca remodelación dendrítica, pérdida sináptica y alteraciones de la materia blanca en hipocampo, corteza prefrontal y auditiva. Estos cambios estructurales y la interrupción de la plasticidad sináptica se deben a la activación del eje HPA, neuroinflamación y estrés oxidativo.
stories.takeaway: Comprender que el ruido ambiental deteriora estructuras clave para la memoria y la regulación emocional sugiere la necesidad de políticas de reducción de ruido y de intervenciones preventivas para proteger la salud cognitiva y mental.
stories.paperTitle: Structural and Functional Brain Alterations Induced by Noise Exposure: A Comprehensive Review
stories.originalAbstract: Noise exposure has become an increasingly prevalent public health concern, with effects extending beyond the auditory system. Accumulating evidence indicates that chronic noise exposure induces both structural and functional alterations in the central nervous system, ultimately affecting cognitive and emotional processes. This review summarizes the impact of noise on key brain regions, including the hippocampus, prefrontal cortex, and auditory cortex. Structurally, noise exposure is associated with reduced neurogenesis, dendritic remodeling, synaptic loss, alterations in white matter and changes in glial activity. Functionally, it disrupts synaptic plasticity mechanisms-such as long-term potentiation and long-term depression-as well as neuronal connectivity, leading to impairments in higher-order cognitive and behavioral functions. These effects are mediated by interconnected mechanisms, including activation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis, neuroinflammation, oxidative stress, and alterations in neurotrophic signaling.
